requirement_review.user_intent: Norven requires Cap to fix the class of failures where phase work, infrastructure checks, or reports substitute for the user's terminal objective.
requirement_review.target_reality: RedCap must keep long-running terminal goals open until their own acceptance criteria are satisfied, and must prevent phase achievements from being reported as terminal completion.
non_goals: claim the full RedCap revival is complete
treat formal usability baseline checks as full revival completion
hide terminal-goal work under status reports or version records

technical_review.rollback_plan: Remove the terminal goal guard command, the terminal goal contract, and Stop hook wiring; leave existing scan and revival evidence untouched.
verification_plan: runtime/bin/redcap gate --task "实现长期目标锚点，防止阶段成果冒充终局成果" --risk-level high --lifecycle-packet assets/contracts/terminal-goal-guard-lifecycle.json
runtime/bin/redcap terminal-goal check --message "RedCap 已经完整复活，正式可用。" --prompt "请汇报完整复活状态"

prompt_context.source_prompt_excerpt: 好，那么你的方案是什么？是否有完善的方案了？是否需要和棱镜讨论来定案？我要求你把这个解决方案执行完成

task_body.requested_outcome: Solve the general class of terminal-goal substitution failures, not only the RedCap revival instance.
task_body.primary_deliverable: A runtime terminal-goal guard, contract, status integration, host hook integration, and task fact anchor that keep full revival open until its own evidence exists.
acceptance_criteria: The contract distinguishes infrastructure usability, scan completion, migration usability, and full revival.
The full revival parent task is reopened or kept open when only phase-level evidence exists.
A final reply that says full revival is complete is rejected unless the terminal-goal contract and task facts prove it.
Formal usability checks explicitly identify themselves as a baseline, not full revival.
The Stop hook runs the terminal-goal guard before allowing final replies.
The UserPromptSubmit hook injects terminal-goal context before Cap plans or drafts the final answer.
At least one non-RedCap terminal-goal fixture proves the mechanism is not RedCap-only.

findings: 终局目标被建模为独立契约和任务账本锚点，状态展示、正式可用基线检查、主机适配器都读取同一契约，避免每个入口各自解释完成状态。
异构评审助手提出的两个 concern 均被采纳，并通过 prism-resolution 检查；完整复活父任务保持 in_progress，阶段成果不能关闭父任务。
终局目标契约包含 RedCap 与非 RedCap 样例，停止前检查会阻断终局冒领，正式可用检查明确只代表基线而非完整复活。

completion_claim.scope: terminal-goal-substitution guard only; this does not claim RedCap full revival completion
